# Subway Seat for tmux

A status bar like a station sign: the session as an orange route bullet (gold while the prefix is held), the active window lit in gold, a clock and a four-colour stripe. The rounded bullet ends need a Nerd Font; no plugins required.

[tmux](https://github.com/tmux/tmux) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/tmux/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.conf`](subway-seat.conf) | ~/.config/tmux/subway-seat.conf |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.conf`](subway-seat-tunnel.conf) | ~/.config/tmux/subway-seat-tunnel.conf |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.conf`](subway-seat-enamel.conf) | ~/.config/tmux/subway-seat-enamel.conf |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.tmux.conf or ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf (after TPM's `run` line, if you use TPM):

```conf
source-file ~/.config/tmux/subway-seat.conf
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.tmux.conf or ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf (after TPM's `run` line, if you use TPM):

```conf
source-file ~/.config/tmux/subway-seat-tunnel.conf
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.tmux.conf or ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf (after TPM's `run` line, if you use TPM):

```conf
source-file ~/.config/tmux/subway-seat-enamel.conf
```
